about: Public features of each library crate that no gated comparison compares directly with its reference, by crate: each by a short stable name, the public items it is reached through, how near it comes to a direct comparison and what a comparison would need. `degree` is one of `step` (compared only as a step inside a larger compared operation), `recorded` (checked against reference output recorded once, which no worker re-runs), `outside-gate` (compared with the reference by an opt-in test or a command the gate does not run), `unit-tests` (unit tests only), `untested` (no tests) and `no-reference` (no reference implements it). A crate listed with no features was reviewed and has none; a crate not listed is not reviewed yet. A feature leaves its list when a gated comparison compares it directly. `cargo xtask check-design` checks the list and holds the count per crate to harness/gate-exceptions.json, so a feature left uncompared is recorded as visibly as a loosened gate.

triergon.name: any-reader-mpegts
triergon.needs: Facade-mpegts compares admission and packet delivery. Facade-mpegts-controls compares carrier, ordinary continuity, PSI, PES and EOF events through AnyOther. Loss, clock discontinuity, interrupted PES, header-only video and unsupported-framer events need checked results.

triergon-capture.name: session-configuration
triergon-capture.needs: ARMv7 parity for the capture configuration cases, which compare configured GOP, rates, VBV and multiplex settings, including a matching refusal for a one-bit buffer on AArch64

triergon-codec-ac3.name: decoder-options
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: The reference has no option equivalent to disabling all dither, AHT zero-bin noise and spectral extension noise. The dither-free lane compares Off where stripping the input gives an equivalent computation. The CRC lanes compare Decoder::with_options with Reject.

triergon-codec-ac3.name: decoder-modes
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: FFmpeg 9.0.2 has no option for the A/52 mode. Its decoder refuses reduced-rate E-AC-3 and does not expose the specification mode's strict dependent-substream and end-of-frame handling or dither generator.

triergon-codec-ac3.name: frame-info
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: The reference does not publish audio block tool flags. The ac3-features oracle compares complete version-8 AC-3 syncframes. Annex E syntax, other bitstream versions and truncated audio blocks need separate oracle coverage.

triergon-codec-ac3.name: bit-position-trace
triergon-codec-ac3.needs: The reference does not publish coded bit positions or full per-block trace state. The dither-free lane compares the pinned result of rewriting the coded dither fields and grades the stripped stream.

triergon-codec-hevc.name: picture-properties
triergon-codec-hevc.needs: Picture properties compare decoded CICP, effective range, aspect ratio and visible planes. The frame reference does not expose the two coded VUI presence bits.

triergon-codec-mpeg1.name: encoder
triergon-codec-mpeg1.needs: capture qualification compares construction and encoding at additional geometries, rates, VBV sizes and GOP lengths, including the refusal of an undersized VBV buffer. The budget-taking entry points need separate comparison

triergon-core.name: reader-protocol
triergon-core.needs: Push comparisons exercise request windows, Yield and Backpressure resume against the blocking rows. Coverage does not establish every ContainerReader, InputCursor, Blocking and Feed entry point or the full failure and reset domain.

triergon-elementary.name: seeking
triergon-elementary.needs: The elementary seek lane compares the landing and packet suffix. It retains thirty declared frame-position and clock differences and one open MPEG audio recovery landing.

triergon-elementary.name: stream-metadata
triergon-elementary.needs: The elementary metadata and wire comparisons cover declared FLAC fields and tag envelopes. Ten declared deviations cover metadata retention, free-format admission and tag dictionary policy. The paired bounds remain due.

triergon-mpegts.name: source-stream-polling
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-source-poll compares the PES output of all five poll forms and checks their source spans. Table, continuity, timeline and diagnostic events have no equivalent full reference trace.

triergon-mpegts.name: fault-and-completion-facts
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-fault-facts compares raw PES headers and the packet consequences of the recovery and completion policies. Physical-end witnesses and malformed-carrier details remain candidate trace facts.

triergon-mpegts.name: reader-views
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-reader-views compares track configuration and time bases, AC-3 syncframes and incomplete extents, DVB segments and opaque ranges. The underlying source signalling has no separate public reference observation.

triergon-mpegts.name: continuity-reader-container-view
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-reader-container compares packet output and ordered carrier evidence, including the confirming source fault. The full typed diagnostic context remains candidate trace evidence.

triergon-mpegts.name: reference-trace-recovery
triergon-mpegts.needs: ts-recovery-trace compares registered, selected-AVC, private-audio and DVB recovery. The isolated-fault contract declares the compound-fault and incomplete-PES differences.

triergon-ogg.name: track-properties
triergon-ogg.needs: Ogg tracks compare identification, setup, comments, timing, configuration and header errors. The contract declares twelve differences in source end clocks, dictionaries and malformed-header handling. The paired bounds remain due.

triergon-playback.name: demux-view-entry-points-outside-the-gated-operations
triergon-playback.needs: Resolve the reordered-edit admission in playback-mov-index. The finite startup and independent segment packet gates are in playback-ts-open.

triergon-playback.name: player-mp4-seeks
triergon-playback.needs: Resolve edit-aware demux seek admission, encoded preroll and terminal trim in playback-mp4-seek.

triergon-playback.name: fifo-delivery-and-pump
triergon-playback.needs: Playback-delivery compares the delivered packet sequence and the Matroska Cluster prefix. Queue and sink lifecycle has no reference counterpart and is exercised by the library tests.

triergon-playback.name: neutral-views
triergon-playback.needs: Playback-source-view checks the neutral track keys, reader and prepared-plan accessors, and DemuxTimes. Three progressive MP4 cases remain open because an implicit fragment loses the decode origin of a known predecessor.

triergon-raw-video.name: configuration-tracking-on-its-own
triergon-raw-video.needs: raw-annex-b, hls-segments and matroska-startup-seek reach the tracker and HEVC startup APIs; playback-source-view compares the initial SPS-derived frame rate. The sample aspect ratio and additional VUI fields are diagnostic only.

triergon-session.name: track-decoding
triergon-session.needs: Track construction and decoding are compared through codecs-files (including AAC MOV and Opus pre-skip across packets) and aac-access-units (fixed and program layouts). Reset PCM differences and session parity gaps remain in the codecs-sessions lanes.

triergon-session.name: audio-session
triergon-session.needs: The session lanes compare PCM, device output and block clocks. Damaged input, trim and drain timestamps, rate changes and reset behaviour have open parity cases.

triergon-session.name: video-session
triergon-session.needs: The session lanes compare RGBA output and reported timestamps. Unsupported profiles and an AVC mid-GOP reset remain open. Clocked video with defined input PTS still needs coverage.
